A little way home

Talk to Mira, collect the seven treasures around the island, make a lantern at her worktable, then carry it to the beacon.

Move with WASD or arrows. E interacts. I opens the pack. You can also click or tap a destination or treasure.

Your progress is saved on this device when storage is available. Movement pauses while a window is open.
